apcoholdings-apcoholdings:lever:aa8d34e5.title: Customer Service Representative
apcoholdings-apcoholdings:lever:aa8d34e5.description: APCO Holdings partners with dealerships across North America to deliver innovative vehicle protection products and services that enhance the ownership experience for customers and drive growth for our partners. Through our family of brands, we bring together industry expertise, technology, and data-driven insights to help dealers strengthen their finance and insurance performance and build lasting relationships with their customers. Our teams work collaboratively across operations, technology, risk, finance, marketing, and sales to deliver solutions that create measurable value and support the continued growth of APCO and the partners we serve. We are looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our Customer Service team. In this role, you will be the voice of APCO, helping customers, dealers, agents, and repair facilities get the information and support they need quickly and professionally. Your work will play an important role in ensuring every customer interaction reflects the high standard of service our partners expect.
responsibilities: Handle a high volume of inbound calls while maintaining strong service levels
Answer questions about coverage, contracts, and claims from customers, dealers, and repair facilities
Resolve customer issues or route inquiries to the appropriate department when needed
Maintain accurate and consistent documentation in company systems
Communicate with key stakeholders to ensure a smooth and positive claims experience
Monitor call queues and maintain agent availability through proper system usage
Anticipate customer needs and deliver solutions with professionalism and empathy
qualifications: Previous customer service experience (call center experience preferred)
Ability to navigate computer systems and maintain accurate documentation
Strong verbal and written communication skills

databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:b7.company: Whether prototyping or building production-ready apps, Replit lets you create software in plain English - with authentication, databases, security, testing, and
databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:b7.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Product Engineer to join as an early member of our new Enterprise team. The consumer story has demonstrated Replit’s magic and now we are seeing use cases emerge in the B2B space that are ripe for innovation and growth. It is a critical area for our success this year and beyond. You can be part of the journey to build and scale features that help teams and organizations of any size be more productive with Replit. This is an opportunity to make meaningful impact and shape the culture and processes from the ground up. Working closely with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and AI engineers, you'll craft solutions that enable our customers to build, deploy, and share their applications seamlessly. This role requires both technical expertise and a deep understanding of user needs to deliver features that make an impact. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: - Build and own features across the full stack that serve enterprise customers, from backend services to user-facing interfaces - Design and implement scalable solutions for teams and organizations. This includes enterprise-readiness features like authentication, permissions, security, and compliance, as well as tools that improve team collaboration and drive adoption within an organization. - Work directly with customers to understand their needs and iterate on solutions - Contribute to technical decisions and architecture for the Enterprise platform - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences - Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering excellence - Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: - Strong full stack engineering skills with experience shipping production code - Experience building B2B or enterprise software products - Comfort working across the stack - from databases and APIs to frontend frameworks - Strong product sense and ability to translate customer needs into technical solutions - Experience with modern web technologies (React, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar) - Track record of shipping high-impact features and taking ownership of projects - Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams - Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and domains NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with enterprise authentication and authorization systems (SSO, SAML, SCIM) - Experience with AI/LLM integration in applications - Understanding of developer tools, internal tools, and workflows - Previous experience in a high-growth startup environment - Contributions to open-source projects TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE: - React, TypeScript, CSS, GraphQL, Node.js, and Postgres THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF: - You prefer working exclusively on backend systems without user interaction - You're uncomfortable with the pace and changing priorities of a startup environment - You require highly structured requirements and aren't comfortable with ambiguity This is a full-time role that is held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Full-Time Employee Benefits Include: 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity 💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only) ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance 🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability 🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave 🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays 🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only) 📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend 🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment 🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only) 🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings ☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only) Want to learn more about what we are up to? - Mee

farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:79b58dbf-55.title: Mobile Engineer - iOS
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:79b58dbf-55.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. TECHNOLOGY We're on a mission to build end-to-end products and technology that powers the an incredible e-commerce experience for luxury customers everywhere, understanding the motivations and needs of our customers and partners, to designing and testing hypotheses, to creating industry-leading experiences for luxury customers. PORTO Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. THE ROLE (Porto or Lisbon based) You will contribute to the end-to-end development of iOS applications driving the long-term mobile strategy planned for Farfetch. You'll write top-notch Swift/Objective-C code and resort to battle hardened design patterns. It isn't just about writing iOS apps, you'll also have the chance to work with UI Automation, Snapshot Testing and automated build pipelines while reporting to the Engineering Lead.
responsibilities: Work on feature development and help improve end-to-end product quality
Contribute for cross team development of common libraries
Help establish best practices on iOS development and contribute for a learning environment
Be committed to Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
Work with other Product Development teams to improve consistency and timing of releases
Create prototypes of new ideas and explore new technologies on the forefront of mobile technology.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:814d8fc0-bea1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Desenvolvedor Inteligência Artificial Pleno based in Brazil. This is an opportunity for a mid-level developer to contribute directly to the development of an innovative Artificial Intelligence solution for processing medical-occupational documents. You will help build and evolve applications that combine software engineering, APIs, data processing, system integrations, and AI-related technologies. The role offers hands-on exposure to Python, Django, FastAPI, JavaScript, SQL databases, OCR, and document-processing workflows. You will work closely with technical and business teams to translate complex rules and requirements into reliable solutions. The environment encourages problem-solving, continuous improvement, and practical innovation. This is a fully remote, project-based opportunity with the potential for contract renewal. Develop and continuously improve an Artificial Intelligence solution focused on processing medical-occupational documents. Build and maintain applications using Python and Django. Develop, maintain, and enhance APIs using FastAPI and RESTful architecture. Create and maintain integrations between different systems, applications, and services. Develop application features and interfaces using JavaScript. Process, structure, organize, and make information available across different workflows and systems. Translate business rules, procedures, standards, and operational manuals into application logic. Develop mechanisms for error identification, handling, monitoring, and control. Support the management and tracking of pending items and exceptions throughout application workflows. Develop communication and information-delivery flows within the solution. Work with relational databases and support data-related development activities. Participate in requirements analysis and collaborate with business stakeholders to understand functional needs. Support testing, validation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of the platform. Use Git and GitHub for source-code versioning and collaborative development. Collaborate with technical and business teams to ensure solutions meet functional and technical objectives. Requirements Professional experience developing applications with Python. Practical experience with the Django framework. Knowledge of JavaScript and its application in web development. Experience with or knowledge of FastAPI. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL. Experience developing integrations between systems and services. Good understanding of REST APIs and API-based integrations. Experience using Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve technical problems. Ability to understand business rules and translate them into effective, maintainable technical solutions. Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence concepts and solutions is desirable. Experience or knowledge of OCR and document-processing technologies is a plus. Knowledge of Google OCR is desirable. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an advantage. Experience or knowledge working with environments integrated with Claude is a plus. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. A proactive mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to learn and contribute to the continuous evolution of the solution. Benefits Fully remote work model. PJ (independent contractor) engagement. Initial 12-month contract, renewable based on business needs and performance. 5 scheduled days of absence. Partnership for vehicle rental. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9b7d03fe-0744-.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9b7d03fe-0744-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Netherlands. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks. Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and product stakeholders. A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of quality

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:495e2642-84c0-41c7.title: Middle Product Marketing Manager - Futurra Group
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:495e2642-84c0-41c7.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Futurra Group — українська мультипродуктова IT-компанія, що працює у сфері EdTech. Ми спеціалізуємося на розробці та просуванні інноваційних cross-платформних продуктів та збираємо потужну команду однодумців — найталановитіших фахівців для роботи над edtech-сервісами, що змінить майбутнє освітніх додатків. Серед наших продуктів: — Навчальна lifestyle-платформа MusesAcademy, яка допомагає жінкам з усього світу долати різні виклики у різних сферах та етапах свого життя через різноманітні експертні навчальних матеріали. — Математичний застосунок MathMaster - допомагає мільйонам користувачів worldwide розв’язувати та вивчати математику легко та доступно, step by step завдяки AI та live-чату з експертами. — Кросплатформенний VPN, який понад 6 років надає доступ до різних web-ресурсів завдяки власним VPN-протоколам. Зараз ми в пошуку Product Marketing Lead на продукт MusesAcademy. MusesAcademy — продукт працює у форматі microlearning та дає користувачам сотні юнітів корисного контенту — від практичних уроків на різні теми, книжок з саморозвитку та аудіоматеріалів з екстра інформацією до чатів з лайфстайл коучами, які можуть порадити з приводу різних життєвих питань у режимі реального часу. Ми шукаємо Product Marketing Lead, який задрайвить нові точки зростання для нашого бізнесу. Ти займатимешся організацією роботи команди в напрямку побудови найефективніших флоу залучення користувачів (web acquisition funnels) та дослідженням й запуском нових піднапрямків в бізнесі, вибудовуючи при цьому процеси, які системно даватимуть результат і допоможуть бізнесу продовжувати кратно зростати. Основні виклики на цій позиції: — Дослідження нових піднапрямків для масштабування через аналіз ринку, трендів та конкурентів. — Будувати найефективніші на ринку флоу залучення користувачів через non-stop експерименти завдяки глибшому розумінню користувачів, їх болів та психології прийняття рішень. — Створення процесів, які будуть давати постійний результат через ефективність системи, а не вдачу. — Координація з кросфункціональними командами: ти працюватимеш з командами маркетингу, аналітики, розробки та продукту, будуючи місток в шляху користувача від кліку на рекламний креатив до потрапляння в продукт. — Розвиток та управління командою: ти будеш розвивати та управляти PMM командою, створюючи умови для постійного зростання та професійного розвитку. Що важливо для цієї ролі: — 3+ роки загального досвіду на позиціях Product Marketing Manager, Product Manager, Growth Manager, Marketing Manager — Бажання розвиватись в управлінні командою — Аналітичний підхід та data-driven мислення: вміння працювати з даними для прийняття обґрунтованих рішень і побудови довгострокових стратегій. — Глибоке розуміння психології аудиторії: вміння знаходити правильні кути продажу. — Масштабування через системи: будувати процеси, які системно даватимуть результат — Вміння досліджувати ринок, актуальні тренди, конкурентів — Рівень англійської: Upper-Intermediate і вище. Ця роль для тебе, якщо ти: — Маєш стратегію в голові, а не просто відчуття на інтуїції. — Мислиш масштабно і хочеш впливати на те, яким буде бізнес уже завтра. — Любиш цифри і постійно шукаєш причинно наслідкові зв’язки через дані. — Хочеш будувати свою сильну команду в оточенні крутих людей. — Орієнтуєшся на результат і шукаєш найоптимальніші шляхи до його досягнення. Futurra Group активно підтримує Україну. Ми є партнером SKELAR foundation, благодійного фонду, що фінансує великі проєкти для військових та надає адресну допомогу різним підрозділам. Окрім того, ми створюємо освітні можливості та надаємо кар’єрні консультації для ветеранів та їх сімей на волонтерській основі Futurra Group побудована завдяки постійним інвестиціям у розвиток сильної команди та її амбіцій. Усі керівники напрямів виросли у компанії, реалізовуючи власні ідеї. Якщо ти шукаєш можливість реалізувати себе
